title: Kissed Crispy Canadian Goose Bake
description: A crispy and adventurous Canadian dish featuring goose fat and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, baked to perfection in a fondue pot. This recipe combines the richness of goose fat with the brightness of lemon and herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, onions, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper, and toss to coat.
In a fondue pot or a large Dutch oven, heat the melted goose fat over medium heat.
Add the potato mixture to the fondue pot and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chicken broth.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
